rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when invoking divine favor or asking for a person's well-being.

example.english: May God bless your family with peace.
example.traditional: 願上帝祝福你一家平安。
example.jyutping: jyun6 soeng6 dai3 zuk1 fuk1 nei5 jat1 gaa1 ping4 on1

rows.note: Use this in casual requests when the intended meaning is to give or send someone something, such as a link.

example.english: When you have time, bless me with that video.
example.jyutping: dak1 haan4 zau6 bei2 tiu4 pin2 ngo5 laa1

rows.note: Use this when an official person or body gives formal approval to a proposal or plan.

example.english: The committee will bless this proposal after reviewing it.
example.traditional: 委員會審議後會批准呢份建議。
example.jyutping: wai2 jyun4 wui6 sam2 ji5 hau6 wui5 pai1 zeon2 ni1 fan6 gin3 ji5

rows.note: Use this when praising or glorifying God, or praising someone for excellence.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 zaan3 mei5 soeng6 dai3
